name: Molossia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and green.
flag.symbolism: Known as the Grand Triune, the flag is Sierra Leone's tricolor turned upside down.

hook: Molossia is blue-white-green from the top, exactly Sierra Leone's flag flipped over.
trivia: Kevin Baugh runs the micronation from his property of about 4.6 hectares near Dayton, Nevada, and calls the property taxes he pays to Storey County foreign aid.
Molossia issues its own currency, the valora.
